rationale: The Court is likely to issue a narrow, hearing-specific holding that a properly served later notice providing the time and place satisfies § 1229a(b)(5)'s requirement of notice "in accordance with paragraph (1) or (2)," notwithstanding an earlier defective NTA. Expect a Sotomayor dissent emphasizing § 1229(a)(2)'s "change or postponement" language and resisting extension-limiting readings of Pereira/Niz-Chavez.
